```{r}
# -----------------------------
# 1) Define treatment & periods
# -----------------------------

treated_country <- "Honduras"
treat_year      <- 2017
pre_period      <- 2005:2016
post_period     <- 2017:2022

# -----------------------------
# 2) Make a clean Synth dataset
# -----------------------------
# Use a fresh numeric id and base::data.frame (not tibble)
d <- all_data_joined %>%
  transmute(
    country     = countryname,
    year        = as.integer(year),
    unit_num    = as.numeric(factor(countryname)),  # <- guaranteed numeric id
    gdp_pc      = as.numeric(gdp_pc),
    unemp       = as.numeric(unemp),
    urban_pop   = as.numeric(urban_pop),
    net_mig     = as.numeric(net_mig),
    population  = as.numeric(population),
    homicide    = as.numeric(homicide),
    estimate    = as.numeric(estimate),
    victim_count= as.numeric(victim_count)          # <- outcome variable
  ) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  # impute only predictors; do NOT touch the outcome
  mutate(across(c(gdp_pc, unemp, urban_pop, net_mig, population, homicide, estimate),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

# -----------------------------
# 3) IDs and predictor selection
# -----------------------------
treated_id <- unique(d$unit_num[d$country == treated_country])
donor_ids  <- setdiff(unique(d$unit_num), treated_id)

predictors_vec <- c("gdp_pc","unemp","urban_pop","net_mig","population","homicide","estimate")

# Keep only years we plan to use
d_use <- d[d$year %in% c(pre_period, post_period), ]


# Keep only lag years with variance across donors (pre-period) for the OUTCOME
keep_lag_years <- Filter(function(y) {
  vals <- d_use[d_use$year == y & d_use$unit_num %in% donor_ids, "victim_count"]
  sum(is.finite(vals)) >= 2 && sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
}, pre_period)
special_lags <- lapply(keep_lag_years, function(y) list("victim_count", y, "mean"))

# Drop predictors with zero variance across donors in pre-period
donor_means <- d_use %>%
  dplyr::filter(year %in% pre_period, unit_num %in% donor_ids) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(country) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(across(all_of(predictors_vec), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
keep_predictors <- names(which(sapply(donor_means[predictors_vec], sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))
if (!length(keep_predictors)) stop("No predictors with donor variance. Adjust predictors_vec.")

# -----------------------------
# 4) dataprep + synth
# -----------------------------
dataprep_out <- dataprep(
  foo                  = d_use,
  predictors           = keep_predictors,
  predictors.op        = "mean",
  special.predictors   = special_lags,
  dependent            = "victim_count",     # <- outcome is victim_count only
  unit.variable        = "unit_num",
  unit.names.variable  = "country",
  time.variable        = "year",
  treatment.identifier = treated_id,
  controls.identifier  = donor_ids,
  time.predictors.prior= pre_period,
  time.optimize.ssr    = pre_period,
  time.plot            = c(pre_period, post_period)
)

synth_out <- synth(dataprep_out)

path.plot(
  synth_out, dataprep_out,
  tr.intake = 2017,  
  Ylab = "Victim Count",
  Xlab = "Year",
  Legend = c("Honduras", "Synthetic Honduras"),
  Main = "Plot 2: Honduras vs Synthetic Control"
)

```
```{r}
#RMSPE pre and post fit and ratio
# --- RMSPE pre/post & ratio -----------------------------------------------
# Time axis and series from Synth outputs
yrs    <- dataprep_out$tag$time.plot
y1     <- drop(dataprep_out$Y1plot)                   # treated outcome path
y0hat  <- drop(dataprep_out$Y0plot %*% synth_out$solution.w)  # synthetic control

# Indices for pre/post using your declared periods
pre_idx  <- yrs %in% pre_period
post_idx <- yrs %in% post_period

# Sanity check: ensure we have data in both windows
if (!any(pre_idx))  warning("No observations in pre_period within time.plot.")
if (!any(post_idx)) warning("No observations in post_period within time.plot.")

# RMSPEs
pre_rmspe  <- sqrt(mean((y1[pre_idx]  - y0hat[pre_idx])^2,  na.rm = TRUE))
post_rmspe <- sqrt(mean((y1[post_idx] - y0hat[post_idx])^2, na.rm = TRUE))

# Guard against divide-by-zero / NA
r_ratio <- if (is.na(pre_rmspe) || pre_rmspe == 0) NA_real_ else post_rmspe / pre_rmspe

# Optional extras for transparency
n_pre  <- sum(pre_idx & is.finite(y1) & is.finite(y0hat))
n_post <- sum(post_idx & is.finite(y1) & is.finite(y0hat))

# --- Table -----------------------------------------------------------------
table_rmspe <- data.frame(
  Treated_Unit = treated_country,
  Treat_Year   = treat_year,
  Pre_RMSPE    = round(pre_rmspe, 3),
  Post_RMSPE   = round(post_rmspe, 3),
  RMSPE_Ratio  = round(r_ratio, 3),
  N_Pre        = n_pre,
  N_Post       = n_post
)

knitr::kable(
  table_rmspe,
  caption = " Pre-/Post-treatment RMSPE and Ratio for Synthetic Control"
)

```

  Gap       = drop(x1_mat) - drop(x0_w),
  row.names = NULL,
  check.names = FALSE
)

# Print a compact view
kable(balance_tbl, digits = 3,
      caption = "Predictor balance (pre-treatment): Honduras vs Synthetic control")

```{r}
# ================================
# PLACEBO-IN-SPACE DISTRIBUTION
# ================================
# Choose which spec to use for the baseline (original vs cleaned):
dp_base   <- dataprep_out     # or dataprep_out2
synth_base<- synth_out        # or synth_out2

yrs        <- dp_base$tag$time.plot
pre_idx    <- yrs %in% pre_period
post_idx   <- yrs %in% post_period
donors_vec <- dp_base$tag$controls.identifier
treated_id <- dp_base$tag$treatment.identifier

# Treated (Honduras) gaps and RMSPEs
y1    <- drop(dp_base$Y1)
y0hat <- drop(dp_base$Y0 %*% synth_base$solution.w)
gap_T <- y1 - y0hat

pre_rmspe_T  <- sqrt(mean(gap_T[pre_idx]^2,  na.rm=TRUE))
post_rmspe_T <- sqrt(mean(gap_T[post_idx]^2, na.rm=TRUE))
ratio_T      <- post_rmspe_T / pre_rmspe_T

# Helper to run one placebo SCM
run_one_placebo <- function(treated_i, donors_i) {
  dp <- dataprep(
    foo                  = d_use,
    predictors           = dp_base$tag$predictors,         # keep same predictors
    predictors.op        = dp_base$tag$predictors.op,
    special.predictors   = dp_base$special.predictors,     # same lags
    dependent            = dp_base$tag$dependent,
    unit.variable        = dp_base$tag$unit.variable,
    unit.names.variable  = dp_base$tag$unit.names.variable,
    time.variable        = dp_base$tag$time.variable,
    treatment.identifier = treated_i,
    controls.identifier  = donors_i,
    time.predictors.prior= pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr    = pre_period,
    time.plot            = c(pre_period, post_period)
  )
  so <- try(synth(dp), silent=TRUE)
  if (inherits(so, "try-error")) return(NULL)

  y1i    <- drop(dp$Y1)
  y0hati <- drop(dp$Y0 %*% so$solution.w)
  gap_i  <- y1i - y0hati
  yrs_i  <- dp$tag$time.plot

  pre_r  <- sqrt(mean(gap_i[yrs_i %in% pre_period]^2,  na.rm=TRUE))
  post_r <- sqrt(mean(gap_i[yrs_i %in% post_period]^2, na.rm=TRUE))
  ratio  <- post_r / pre_r

  list(gap=gap_i, yrs=yrs_i, pre_rmspe=pre_r, post_rmspe=post_r, ratio=ratio,
       treated_id=treated_i)
}

# Run placebos: each donor becomes "treated", controls are the rest (exclude actual treated)
placebos <- lapply(donors_vec, function(ii) run_one_placebo(ii, setdiff(donors_vec, ii)))
ok      <- which(!vapply(placebos, is.null, logical(1)))
placebos<- placebos[ok]

# Pre-fit filter (K = 2: keep only placebos with good pre-fit relative to treated)
K <- 2
pre_vec        <- vapply(placebos, function(p) p$pre_rmspe, numeric(1))
keep_mask      <- pre_vec <= (K * pre_rmspe_T)
placebos_keep  <- placebos[keep_mask]

# Exact p-value from RMSPE ratio (upper tail)
ratio_vec_keep <- vapply(placebos_keep, function(p) p$ratio, numeric(1))
exact_p_ratio  <- mean(ratio_vec_keep >= ratio_T)

# ------- Pointwise (year-by-year) p-values (standardized gaps) -------
# Standardize by each unit's pre-RMSPE to equalize noise scales
std_gap_T <- gap_T / pre_rmspe_T

std_gaps_placebos <- lapply(placebos_keep, function(p) {
  p$gap / p$pre_rmspe
})

years_post <- yrs[post_idx]
pointwise_p <- sapply(years_post, function(tt) {
  # treated standardized gap at year tt
  gT <- std_gap_T[yrs == tt]
  # gather each placebo standardized gap at the same calendar year
  gp <- vapply(std_gaps_placebos, function(g) g[yrs == tt], numeric(1))
  mean(gp >= gT)  # upper-tail: "as large or larger than treated"
})

summary_tab <- data.frame(
  Pre_RMSPE   = round(pre_rmspe_T, 3),
  Post_RMSPE  = round(post_rmspe_T, 3),
  RMSPE_Ratio = round(ratio_T, 3),
  Placebos_Kept = length(placebos_keep),
  Exact_p_Ratio = round(exact_p_ratio, 2)
)
kable(summary_tab, caption = "Randomization inference summary (ratio-based exact p)")

pointwise_tab <- data.frame(
  Year = years_post,
  Pointwise_p = round(pointwise_p, 2)
)
kable(pointwise_tab, caption = "Pointwise permutation p-values (standardized gaps)")

# ------- Visuals -------
# (1) Placebo gaps overlay vs Honduras
plot(yrs, gap_T, type="l", lwd=3, xlab="Year", ylab="Gap (HND − Synthetic)",
     main=sprintf("Placebo-in-space gaps (K=%g). Exact p (ratio) = %.2f", K, exact_p_ratio))
abline(h=0, lty=3); abline(v=max(pre_period)+1, lty=3)
for (p in placebos_keep) lines(p$yrs, p$gap, col=gray(0.7, 0.7))
lines(yrs, gap_T, lwd=3, col="blue")
```

#Robustness and re run using the backfilled data

```{r}
#--------------------------#
# Backfill donor outcomes for 2017 - 2019 only (never Honduras and never pre_treatment)  
# -----------------------------
# 1) Set treatment & windows
# -----------------------------
treated_country <- "Honduras"
treat_year      <- 2017
pre_period      <- 2005:2016
post_period     <- 2017:2022
all_years       <- c(pre_period, post_period)

# -----------------------------
# 2) Build clean base data (impute predictors only)
# -----------------------------
d <- all_data_joined %>%
  transmute(
    country      = countryname,
    year         = as.integer(year),
    unit_num     = as.numeric(factor(countryname)),
    gdp_pc       = as.numeric(gdp_pc),
    unemp        = as.numeric(unemp),
    urban_pop    = as.numeric(urban_pop),
    net_mig      = as.numeric(net_mig),
    population   = as.numeric(population),
    homicide     = as.numeric(homicide),
    estimate     = as.numeric(estimate),
    victim_count = as.numeric(victim_count)   # OUTCOME
  ) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(across(c(gdp_pc, unemp, urban_pop, net_mig, population, homicide, estimate),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  as.data.frame()

treated_id     <- unique(d$unit_num[d$country == treated_country])
donor_ids      <- setdiff(unique(d$unit_num), treated_id)
predictors_vec <- c("gdp_pc","unemp","urban_pop","net_mig","population","homicide","estimate")

# Keep only years we use
d_use <- d[d$year %in% all_years, ]

# -----------------------------
# 3) COMPLETE PANEL + SENSITIVITY IMPUTATION for donors (2017–2019)
#    (treat donor zeros as missing if donor had positive pre-2017 victims)
# -----------------------------
fill_years <- 2017:2019

# (i) complete panel
d_use <- d_use %>%
  group_by(unit_num, country) %>%
  tidyr::complete(
    year = all_years,
    fill = list(
      gdp_pc = NA_real_, unemp = NA_real_, urban_pop = NA_real_,
      net_mig = NA_real_, population = NA_real_, homicide = NA_real_,
      estimate = NA_real_, victim_count = NA_real_
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# (ii) re-impute predictors for any added rows (never touch outcome here)
d_use <- d_use %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  mutate(across(c(gdp_pc, unemp, urban_pop, net_mig, population, homicide, estimate),
                ~ ifelse(is.na(.), mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), .))) %>%
  ungroup()

# (iii) treat zeros as missing only for donors with positive pre-signal
donor_has_signal <- d_use %>%
  filter(unit_num %in% donor_ids, year %in% pre_period) %>%
  group_by(unit_num) %>%
  summarise(pre_pos = any(victim_count > 0, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(pre_pos) %>% pull(unit_num)

mask_zero_post <- d_use$unit_num %in% donor_has_signal &
  d_use$year %in% fill_years &
  !is.na(d_use$victim_count) &
  d_use$victim_count == 0
message("Re-coded ", sum(mask_zero_post),
        " donor zero cells (2017–2019) to NA for sensitivity.")
d_use$victim_count[mask_zero_post] <- NA_real_

# (iv) backfill donor NAs in 2017–2019 using donor pre-trend/mean
donor_pre <- d_use %>%
  filter(unit_num %in% donor_ids, year %in% pre_period, is.finite(victim_count)) %>%
  select(unit_num, year, victim_count)
donor_pre_mean <- if (nrow(donor_pre)) mean(donor_pre$victim_count, na.rm = TRUE) else 0

imputed_cells <- 0L
for (id in donor_ids) {
  pos_to_fill <- which(d_use$unit_num == id &
                         d_use$year %in% fill_years &
                         is.na(d_use$victim_count))
  if (!length(pos_to_fill)) next
  
  pre_idx <- which(d_use$unit_num == id &
                     d_use$year %in% pre_period &
                     is.finite(d_use$victim_count))
  
  if (length(pre_idx) >= 3) {
    fit   <- lm(victim_count ~ year, data = d_use[pre_idx, c("victim_count","year")])
    preds <- predict(fit, newdata = data.frame(year = d_use$year[pos_to_fill]))
  } else if (length(pre_idx) >= 1) {
    preds <- rep(mean(d_use$victim_count[pre_idx], na.rm = TRUE), length(pos_to_fill))
  } else {
    preds <- rep(donor_pre_mean, length(pos_to_fill))
  }
  preds <- round(pmax(preds, 0), 0)
  d_use$victim_count[pos_to_fill] <- preds
  imputed_cells <- imputed_cells + length(pos_to_fill)
}
message("Sensitivity imputation filled ", imputed_cells, " donor cells in 2017–2019.")

# coerce types for Synth
d_use <- as.data.frame(d_use)
d_use$unit_num <- as.numeric(d_use$unit_num)
d_use$year     <- as.integer(d_use$year)
d_use$country  <- as.character(d_use$country)

# -----------------------------
# 4) First Synth (to get weights), using full donor_ids
# -----------------------------
# pre-treatment lags to keep
years_pre  <- sort(intersect(pre_period, unique(d_use$year)))
donor_mask <- d_use$unit_num %in% donor_ids
keep_lag_years <- years_pre[
  sapply(years_pre, function(yy) {
    vals <- as.numeric(d_use$victim_count[d_use$year == yy & donor_mask])
    n_ok <- sum(is.finite(vals)); s <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    (n_ok >= 2) && is.finite(s) && (s > 0)
  })
]
special_lags <- lapply(keep_lag_years, function(yy) list("victim_count", yy, "mean"))

# keep predictors with variance across donors
donor_means <- d_use %>%
  filter(year %in% pre_period, unit_num %in% donor_ids) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(predictors_vec), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
keep_predictors <- names(which(sapply(donor_means[predictors_vec], sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))

dataprep_out <- dataprep(
  foo                  = d_use,
  predictors           = keep_predictors,
  predictors.op        = "mean",
  special.predictors   = special_lags,
  dependent            = "victim_count",
  unit.variable        = "unit_num",
  unit.names.variable  = "country",
  time.variable        = "year",
  treatment.identifier = treated_id,
  controls.identifier  = donor_ids,
  time.predictors.prior= pre_period,
  time.optimize.ssr    = pre_period,
  time.plot            = all_years
)
synth_out <- synth(dataprep_out)

# -----------------------------
# 5) CLEAN donors: drop any positive-weight donor with 2017–2019 zero/NA
# -----------------------------
id_map <- unique(d_use[, c("unit_num","country")])
weights_df <- merge(
  data.frame(unit_num = donor_ids, weight = as.numeric(synth_out$solution.w)),
  id_map, by = "unit_num", all.x = TRUE
)
weights_pos <- subset(weights_df, weight > 0)

bad_ids <- d_use %>%
  filter(unit_num %in% weights_pos$unit_num, year %in% fill_years) %>%
  group_by(unit_num) %>%
  summarise(bad = any(is.na(victim_count) | victim_count == 0), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(bad) %>% pull(unit_num)

message("Dropping ", length(bad_ids), " positive-weight donors with zero/NA in 2017–2019.")
donor_ids_clean <- setdiff(donor_ids, bad_ids)
if (length(donor_ids_clean) < 2) stop("Too few donors after cleaning; relax the rule.")

# Recompute lags/predictors for CLEAN donors
donor_mask2 <- d_use$unit_num %in% donor_ids_clean
keep_lag_years2 <- years_pre[
  sapply(years_pre, function(yy) {
    vals <- as.numeric(d_use$victim_count[d_use$year == yy & donor_mask2])
    n_ok <- sum(is.finite(vals)); s <- sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
    (n_ok >= 2) && is.finite(s) && (s > 0)
  })
]
if (!length(keep_lag_years2)) stop("No valid pre-treatment lag years for cleaned donors.")
special_lags2 <- lapply(keep_lag_years2, function(yy) list("victim_count", yy, "mean"))

donor_means2 <- d_use %>%
  filter(year %in% pre_period, unit_num %in% donor_ids_clean) %>%
  group_by(country) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(predictors_vec), ~ mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)), .groups = "drop")
keep_predictors2 <- names(which(sapply(donor_means2[predictors_vec], sd, na.rm = TRUE) > 0))
if (!length(keep_predictors2)) stop("No predictors with donor variance after cleaning.")

# -----------------------------
# 6) Re-run Synth with CLEAN donors
# -----------------------------
dataprep_out2 <- dataprep(
  foo                  = d_use,
  predictors           = keep_predictors2,
  predictors.op        = "mean",
  special.predictors   = special_lags2,
  dependent            = "victim_count",
  unit.variable        = "unit_num",
  unit.names.variable  = "country",
  time.variable        = "year",
  treatment.identifier = treated_id,
  controls.identifier  = donor_ids_clean,
  time.predictors.prior= pre_period,
  time.optimize.ssr    = pre_period,
  time.plot            = all_years
)
synth_out2 <- synth(dataprep_out2)
```

# POST-TREATMENT TABLES
# Uses objects from your script:

yrs      <- dataprep_out2$tag$time.plot
y1       <- drop(dataprep_out2$Y1)
y0hat    <- drop(dataprep_out2$Y0 %*% synth_out2$solution.w)

# Split pre / post
pre_idx  <- yrs %in% pre_period
post_idx <- yrs %in% post_period

# Gaps
gap_all  <- y1 - y0hat
gap_post <- gap_all[post_idx]


tableA <- data.frame(
  Year = yrs[post_idx],
  ATT  = round(gap_post, 2)
)

# If you later compute pointwise permutation p-values, add them here:
# tableA$Perm_p <- pointwise_pvals_vector[match(tableA$Year, years_vector)]
# --- Table B: Summary (RMSPE, ratio, and (optional) exact p) ---

# Root mean squared prediction error pre/post
pre_rmspe  <- sqrt(mean((y1[pre_idx]  - y0hat[pre_idx])^2,  na.rm = TRUE))
post_rmspe <- sqrt(mean((y1[post_idx] - y0hat[post_idx])^2, na.rm = TRUE))
r_ratio    <- post_rmspe / pre_rmspe

# If you have placebo results, plug in here; otherwise leave NA
exact_p           <- NA_real_  # replace once you compute via placebos
n_valid_placebos  <- NA_integer_

tableB <- data.frame(
  Pre_RMSPE   = round(pre_rmspe, 3),
  Post_RMSPE  = round(post_rmspe, 3),
  RMSPE_Ratio = round(r_ratio, 3)
)

kable(
  tableB,
  caption = "Summary of post-treatment fit, RMSPE ratio, and randomization inference"
)

# Robustness test for LLO
```{r}
# ---- Leave-One-Out Test ----

yrs   <- dataprep_out2$tag$time.plot
y1    <- drop(dataprep_out2$Y1)
y0hat <- drop(dataprep_out2$Y0 %*% synth_out2$solution.w)
gap   <- y1 - y0hat

# Positive-weight donors
weights_clean <- data.frame(
  unit_num = dataprep_out2$tag$controls.identifier,
  Weight   = as.numeric(synth_out2$solution.w)
)
id_map <- unique(d_use[, c("unit_num","country")])
weights_clean <- merge(weights_clean, id_map, by="unit_num", all.x=TRUE)
pos_donors <- weights_clean$unit_num[weights_clean$Weight > 0]

# Helper: run SCM with one donor dropped
run_loo <- function(drop_id) {
  donors_new <- setdiff(dataprep_out2$tag$controls.identifier, drop_id)
  dp <- dataprep(
    foo = d_use,
    predictors = dataprep_out2$tag$predictors,
    predictors.op = "mean",
    special.predictors = dataprep_out2$special.predictors,
    dependent = "victim_count",
    unit.variable = "unit_num",
    unit.names.variable = "country",
    time.variable = "year",
    treatment.identifier = dataprep_out2$tag$treatment.identifier,
    controls.identifier = donors_new,
    time.predictors.prior = pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr = pre_period,
    time.plot = c(pre_period, post_period)
  )
  so <- synth(dp)
  gap_new <- drop(dp$Y1) - drop(dp$Y0 %*% so$solution.w)
  list(yrs=dp$tag$time.plot, gap=gap_new)
}

# Run LOO for each positive-weight donor
loo_results <- lapply(pos_donors, run_loo)

# Plot
plot(yrs, gap, type="n", xlab="Year", ylab="Gap: Honduras - Synthetic",
     main="Plot 7: Leave-One-Out Robustness Test")
abline(h=0, lty=3); abline(v=treat_year, lty=3)
for (loo in loo_results) lines(loo$yrs, loo$gap, col=gray(0.7,0.6))
lines(yrs, gap, col="blue", lwd=2)  # baseline
legend("topleft", legend=c("Baseline Honduras","LOO gaps"),
       col=c("blue", "grey"), lty=1, lwd=c(2,1), bty="n")

# ---- Collect LOO RMSPE stats ----

get_rmspe <- function(dp, so) {
  yrs <- dp$tag$time.plot
  gap <- drop(dp$Y1) - drop(dp$Y0 %*% so$solution.w)
  pre_rmspe  <- sqrt(mean(gap[yrs %in% pre_period]^2,  na.rm=TRUE))
  post_rmspe <- sqrt(mean(gap[yrs %in% post_period]^2, na.rm=TRUE))
  c(pre=pre_rmspe, post=post_rmspe, ratio=post_rmspe/pre_rmspe)
}

# Baseline Honduras stats
base_stats <- get_rmspe(dataprep_out2, synth_out2)

# Loop over positive-weight donors
loo_stats <- lapply(pos_donors, function(drop_id) {
  donors_new <- setdiff(dataprep_out2$tag$controls.identifier, drop_id)
  dp <- dataprep(
    foo = d_use,
    predictors = dataprep_out2$tag$predictors,
    predictors.op = "mean",
    special.predictors = dataprep_out2$special.predictors,
    dependent = "victim_count",
    unit.variable = "unit_num",
    unit.names.variable = "country",
    time.variable = "year",
    treatment.identifier = dataprep_out2$tag$treatment.identifier,
    controls.identifier = donors_new,
    time.predictors.prior = pre_period,
    time.optimize.ssr = pre_period,
    time.plot = c(pre_period, post_period)
  )
  so <- synth(dp)
  stats <- get_rmspe(dp, so)
  data.frame(Dropped= id_map$country[id_map$unit_num==drop_id],
             Pre_RMSPE= round(stats["pre"],3),
             Post_RMSPE= round(stats["post"],3),
             Ratio= round(stats["ratio"],3))
})

loo_table <- do.call(rbind, loo_stats)



```
